risk_note: RV2 money follow-up of B2-07e (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1), orchestrator ruling D10-431: W11's paid_at is the bill line's booked time when it carries a readable one, else 00:00 +08:00 of the bill day (@couli/domain chinaDayRange(billDate).start through instant()); only a bill day that is not a date falls back to the injected Clock.
